about.description: cgUSD is a rebasing, Treasury-backed dollar token issued by Cygnus Finance. Users deposit USDC/USDT and receive cgUSD. reserves are deployed into short-duration U. S. Treasury bills, and yield is reflected through a rising rebasing index rather than a separate yield token. Redemptions target 1 cgUSD ≈ 1 USDC, but withdrawals can be delayed (e. g. , several days) due to underlying Treasury settlement. Key risks include issuer/operational risk, custodial and U. S. Treasury exposure, smart-contract risk on Base, and redemption-liquidity timing risk.
